items.subject: Updates
items.details: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Receipt of request from Mr. Venkatachalam Ramaswamy and Ms. Aparna T. C., seeking reclassification from the "Promoter / Promoter Group" category to the "Public" category '.

items.subject: Resignation
items.details: Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Venkatchalam Ramaswamy as Non- Executive Director of the company w.e.f. November 11, 2026.

items.subject: Shareholders meeting
items.details: IIFL Finance Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Extra-Ordinary General Meeting to be held on Friday, December 04, 2026

items.subject: General Updates
items.details: Waaree Energies Limited has informed the Exchange about Clarification on the news article published by Moneycontrol on November 11, 2026 titled "Waaree admitted misreporting solar import origin in submission to US trade commission"
